Monica / Elliot — looking at similar reports we've had, this is often an interplay of three things: 1) the email client dropping buttons when the HTML contains nested <table> CTA markup, 2) some enterprise proxies stripping style attributes, and 3) Gmail/Outlook rendering differences when there are long inline base64 images.

Immediate remediation steps I recommend:
1) Resend the invite as a multipart/alternative where the plain-text part includes the full activation URL on its own line (so recipients can copy/paste).
2) Attach the raw .eml of the invite (we can generate this from the send logs) so their IT can inspect headers.
3) If resend fails, generate a one-off direct activation URL (expires in 72h) and paste into the body — we can extend if they need more time.

I've attached a short checklist (resend-instructions.txt) you can use when you resend. If this becomes a recurring pattern for Solenovo's domain we should request their mail/security team whitelist the sending subdomain or allow inline styles from our domain.

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Lina — following up as promised. I just resent the supplier portal invite but included: 1) a plain-text activation URL in the message body, 2) the raw .eml file for your IT team to inspect, and 3) a short-screen attachment showing the alternative link location in the email client (attached).

Workaround steps for your procurement team:
- Check the bottom of the email for a plain URL labeled "Activate supplier account:" — some clients render the button visually but hide it behind the preview pane.
- If the URL is still not clickable, copy/paste it into a browser (it will open the activation page directly).
- If you're behind an email gateway that strips HTML, ask your mail admin to allow redwood.com for that envelope.

I've also created a one-off activation link that will expire in 72 hours and pasted it at the top of the message body so you can complete setup immediately: https://portal.redwood.com/activate/one-off/abc123-def456 (expires 72h).

Let me know when you've completed the activation and I'll confirm your vendor record and PO visibility. Sorry for the friction — we'll follow up with engineering to harden the invite template.

Thanks,
